findings.quote: On the headline numbers Bizee Standard costs $50 less than LegalZoom Pro and Premium costs $100 more than LegalZoom Premium.
findings.problem: Arithmetic error. Bizee Premium is $299 + state fee and LegalZoom Premium LLC is $299 + state fee (same base; both $399 with the $100 example). The difference is $0, not $100. Both prices verified on live pages.
findings.fix: Replace with 'Bizee Premium and LegalZoom Premium both list $299 before state fees.'

findings.quote: None of the six alternatives above sells wills, trusts and LLC formation together. / LegalZoom is the only provider here that lists wills, trusts and LLC formation together.
findings.problem: Contradicts the page's own Rocket Lawyer row and section: Rocket Lawyer lists unlimited legal documents plus a free first LLC/corporation/nonprofit registration ($99 after). Rocketlawyer.com/pricing confirms both. The 'only provider' claim is unsupported.
findings.fix: Rephrase to a verifiable fact, e.g. 'LegalZoom lists priced wills, living trusts and LLC formation as separate products on one site; Rocket Lawyer bundles documents and LLC registration in a membership.' Remove 'only provider'.

findings.quote: This page lists products and their published prices; it is not legal advice.
findings.problem: A legal 'not advice' disclaimer sits in the intro (GATE Disclaimer placement: disclaimer-at-top).
findings.fix: Delete from the intro; keep the disclaimer as the page's final element only.

findings.quote: Trust & Will's page does not state a couple price for these plans, so the couple comparison needs a check at checkout. / Check the price shown at checkout, along with the renewal terms for consultations, before comparing totals.
findings.problem: Unlinked directives to verify (unlinked-directive gate). Also the Trust & Will pricing page has an Individual/Couple toggle, so 'does not state a couple price' may be wrong.
findings.fix: Delete the directives or link the exact page (https://www.trustandwill.com/pricing is an external link not allowed; so state the fact only). Re-check the Couple toggle and state any price shown.

findings.quote: Attorney support adds $299 to the Trust Plan. / Trust & Will lists attorney support separately at $299 on the Trust Plan
findings.problem: trustandwill.com/pricing shows 'Attorney Support +$299' under both the Trust Plan and the Will Plan columns; page says Trust Plan only.
findings.fix: Say attorney support adds $299 to either the Will Plan or the Trust Plan, and fix the $798 example wording accordingly.
